elements.title: Figure 4.—Value of Nonfuel Mineral Commodities Produced in 2023, by State
elements.content: Map of the United States with states colored by value of nonfuel mineral commodities produced in 2023. Color legend: 0 to 0.5 billion dollars (lightest), >0.5 to 1.5 billion dollars (light orange), >1.5 to 3 billion dollars (orange), >3 to 10 billion dollars (red). States in red include Texas, Arizona, Nevada, Minnesota, California, Alaska, Michigan, Wyoming, Missouri, Utah, Pennsylvania, Colorado, Minnesota, Missouri, Texas, and others. States in lightest color include North Dakota, Delaware, Rhode Island, Maine, Hawaii, Vermont, New Hampshire, West Virginia, Nebraska, Connecticut, Massachusetts, Mississippi, Maryland, Idaho, New Jersey, Oregon, South Dakota, Washington, Iowa, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Arkansas, Oklahoma, Montana, Indiana, New Mexico, Wisconsin, Virginia, South Carolina, New York, Illinois, Tennessee, Alabama, Georgia, Florida, North Carolina.
